reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this is not a random wellness buy. A named lab report, a known dose and the empty-box refund make one box at $24.99 an easy risk.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I would not buy a second box until I know it did something, and a lab report only proves what is in it, not that it works for me.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me not to take it, or a blood test showing my magnesium is normal.
